build_hf_biencoder_components: build a biencoder model with HF BERT, RoBERTa, or DeBERTa encoder and tensorizer from config
create_bert_tensorizer: create a BertTensorizer that tokenizes text with BERT tokenizer and pads to max length
create_hf_encoder: create a HFBertEncoder with projection layer and custom dropout from HuggingFace BERT config
get_optimizer: get an AdamW optimizer with weight decay grouping for HF model parameters
add_special_tokens: add special tokens to a tokenizer by remapping unused token IDs in the vocabulary
